result.brief: 提出以对象为中心、跨帧语义持久的视频 tokenizer，将视觉特征绑定为稳定语义单元，显著减少潜变量 token 数并提升下游流模型生成效率。
result.reason: Object-centric temporally persistent video tokenizer producing compact continuous latents for flow-model generation; directly a video representation/tokenizer contribution serving video generation.
